title: Modernize Authentication System
problem_statement: Legacy VB6 login form lacks modern security standards and cannot integrate with enterprise identity systems
risk_if_unaddressed: Security breaches, compliance violations, inability to integrate with SSO systems
suggested_approach: Replace VB6 login form with ASP.NET Core Identity, implement JWT tokens, add MFA support

title: Convert Check Balance Form to ASP.NET Core
problem_statement: frmcheckbalance form represents core banking functionality that needs modern web UI
risk_if_unaddressed: Continued dependency on legacy UI, poor user experience, maintenance burden
suggested_approach: Create Razor Page with Bootstrap UI, implement async data access, add input validation
success_criteria: Responsive web UI for balance inquiry

title: Replace ADO with Entity Framework
problem_statement: Direct ADO usage creates security vulnerabilities and maintenance challenges
risk_if_unaddressed: SQL injection attacks, poor performance, difficult database migrations
suggested_approach: Create Entity Framework models, implement repository pattern, add connection pooling
success_criteria: All database operations use Entity Framework

title: Implement Automated Testing Framework
problem_statement: No automated testing capability increases regression risk during modernization
risk_if_unaddressed: Undetected regressions, poor code quality, difficult refactoring
suggested_approach: Add xUnit test project, implement integration tests, set up CI/CD pipeline
success_criteria: Unit tests for all business logic
UI tests for critical user journeys
